title: *ETH100– GDB SOLUTION BY mano*
text:
*ETH100– GDB SOLUTION BY mano*

*If I were in Hassan’s position I would choose Option 1* giving Bilal another opportunity redistributing some of his tasks among the group and helping him complete his work. Understanding and supporting a teammate going through a genuine hardship is also an important part of being an effective citizen and not just meeting deadlines.

*Three Logical Arguments:*

*Empathy:* 
 Empathy means placing yourself in another person’s situation instead of judging him only by what is visible. Bilal’s delays are not due to carelessness but to real family and financial problems. As Hassan I would try to understand his circumstances first and give him a fair chance to improve rather than reacting immediately.
*Flexibility and Kindness:* 
An effective citizen shows flexibility by adapting to difficult situations instead of being rigid and kindness by supporting others in need. I would redistribute some of Bilal’s tasks among the group members so the project stays on track while also helping Bilal manage the rest of his work without extra pressure.
*Avoiding Arrogance and Rudeness:* 
Reporting Bilal immediately without trying to help him first could reflect harsh and arrogant leadership rather than fair leadership. I would instead set clear deadlines and check his progress regularly staying firm on responsibility while avoiding rudeness toward a struggling team member.

So in my opinion Showing empathy does not mean ignoring responsibility. A good leader balances understanding flexibility and commitment so that both the team member and the project succeed together. This is why Option 1 is the better choice for Hassan.
